pages.text: The $(bold)Comparator$() has two modes (click the front torch):$(br)$(li)$(bold)Compare$() — output stays on unless a stronger signal comes in the side.$(li)$(bold)Subtract$() — output equals back input minus the larger side input.
pages.title: Comparator

pages.text: $(bold)Its real magic is reading.$() Put a comparator against a chest, barrel, furnace, brewing stand, cake, cauldron, or item frame and it emits a signal $(italic)proportional to the contents$() — the cornerstone of every storage readout in $(l:6_reading/comparator)Reading & Displays$().
pages.title: Reading the World
